questions.prompt_html: \text{设连续随机变量}X\text{的概率密度为}f(x)=\frac{1}{2}e^{-|x|},\text{则}E(X),\ D(X)\text{分别为}( ).
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}E(X) & = \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty} \frac{1}{2} x e^{-|x|} dx = 0 \ (\text{被积函数为奇函数})\ , \\D(X) & = E(X^2) - E^2(X) = \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty} \frac{1}{2} x^2 e^{-|x|} dx = \int_{0}^{+\infty} x^2 e^{-x} dx = 1 + 1 = 2 \ (\text{被积函数为偶函数})\ .\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{设随机变量}X\text{的分布函数为}F(x)=\begin{cases}1-\dfrac{a^{1}}{x^{3}},\ x\geq a\\ 0,\quad\text{其它}\end{cases},\text{其中}a>0,\text{则}E(X),D(X)\text{为()}.

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{由概率密度函数的性质：}\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}x(x)dx=1,\text{有}\int_{0}^{1}(ax^{2}+bx+c)dx=1,\text{即}\\&\quad \frac{1}{3}a+\frac{b}{2}+c=1.\quad ①\\&\text{又由}E(X)=\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}xf(x)dx=\int_{0}^{1}x(ax^{2}+bx+c)dx=\frac{a}{4}+\frac{b}{3}+\frac{c}{2},\text{有}\\&\quad \frac{1}{4}a+\frac{1}{3}b+\frac{1}{2}c=0.5.\quad ②\\&\text{再由}E(X^{2})=\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}x^{2}f(x)dx=\int_{0}^{1}x^{2}(ax^{2}+bx+c)dx=\frac{1}{5}a+\frac{1}{4}b+\frac{1}{3}c,\text{有}\\&\quad \frac{1}{5}a+\frac{1}{4}b+\frac{1}{3}c=0.4.\quad ③\\&\text{解由式①、②、③联立的方程组，得}a=12,b=-12,c=3.\end{aligned}
